news.n_ind_nalanda: Fleeing monks say the great monastery of Nalanda in Bihar has been burned by Turkic horsemen, and its library burned for many days.
news.n_ind_constantinople_1204: Merchants from Aden tell a strange tale: Frankish warriors who set out to fight for Jerusalem have instead taken and sacked Constantinople.
news.n_ind_aibak_sultan: They say the ghulam Aibak, the Ghurids' governor in India, now rules in his own right since his master's death.
news.n_ind_aibak_polo: News from Lahore: Sultan Aibak fell from his horse during a game of chaugan and was killed.
news.n_ind_iltutmish: In Delhi Iltutmish, the late sultan's son-in-law and himself a former ghulam, has taken the throne. They say he was once sold in the market at Bukhara.
news.n_ind_tarain: Sultan Iltutmish has defeated his rival Yildiz, ruler of Ghazni, at Tarain. Now Delhi answers to no one.
news.n_ind_bukhara: Refugees from the west speak of the Mongols: they have taken Bukhara and Samarkand, and almost nothing is left of those cities.
news.n_ind_indus: They say the Mongol khan Genghis routed the Shah of Khwarazm right on the bank of the Indus, and the shah swam the river on his horse to escape.
news.n_ind_bengal_subdued: Delhi's army has subdued Lakhnauti: the defiant ruler of Bengal, Iwaz Khalji, has been killed, and tribute from the east flows to the sultan again.
news.n_ind_caliph_robe: Envoys of the caliph have arrived from Baghdad with a robe of honour for Sultan Iltutmish. The Friday sermon now hails him as a lawful sovereign.
news.n_ind_gwalior: After a long siege the sultan's troops have taken the cliff-top fortress of Gwalior.
news.n_ind_ujjain: Sultan Iltutmish has raided Malwa and plundered ancient Ujjain.
news.n_ind_razia: Incredible news from Delhi: Sultan Iltutmish has died, and after some turmoil his daughter Razia has been set on the throne.
news.n_ind_razia_death: They say Sultan Razia is dead: the nobles rose against her, and she could not win back her throne.
news.n_ind_lahore_mongols: The Mongols have taken and ravaged Lahore. Those who survived are fleeing east.
news.n_ind_nasiruddin: The new sultan Nasir al-Din Mahmud, they say, copies the Quran by hand and lives modestly, while Balban rules for him.
news.n_ind_konark: Pilgrims from the east say the king of Kalinga is building a Sun temple by the sea in the shape of a huge stone chariot, with wheels as tall as a man.
news.n_ind_jagadu: Word from Gujarat tells of famine and of a Jain merchant, Jagadu, who feeds whole districts from his granaries.
news.n_ind_baghdad: Terrible news from the west: the Mongols have taken Baghdad and executed the caliph. Scholars say the Tigris turned black with the ink of drowned books.
news.n_ind_ain_jalut: Merchants from Egypt say the Mamluks have beaten the Mongols in Syria. For the first time someone has stopped their army.
news.n_ind_balban: Balban, who ruled for years from behind the sultan, has now taken the throne of Delhi himself.
news.n_ind_yuan: Sailors from Malacca say the Mongol khan Kublai has given his realm in China a new name: Yuan.
news.n_ind_song_fall: News from the east: the last Song emperor of China has died in a sea battle. All China is now under the Mongols.
news.n_ind_tughril: Sultan Balban marched to Bengal himself and executed the rebel governor Tughril. They say gallows lined the bazaar of Lakhnauti.
news.n_ind_prince_muhammad: Sultan Balban's favourite son has fallen fighting the Mongols in the Punjab. His poet, young Khusrau, was taken prisoner.
news.n_ind_balban_death: Old Sultan Balban has died. They say he never recovered from grief after his son's death.
news.n_ind_khalji: There is a new dynasty in Delhi: the old general Jalal al-Din Khalji has seized power. The old Turkish nobility is displeased.
news.n_ind_ghazan: Merchants from Hormuz say Ghazan Khan, the Mongol ruler of Persia, has embraced Islam.
news.n_ind_alauddin: The sultan's nephew Alauddin has returned from a raid on Devagiri with mountains of gold, killed his uncle and taken the throne. He hands out gold by the fistful.
news.n_ind_gujarat_conquest: Sultan Alauddin's armies have conquered Gujarat. They say the temple of Somnath has been plundered again.
news.n_ind_ranthambore: The Rajput fortress of Ranthambore has fallen. Its defender Hammir Dev died rather than surrender.
news.n_ind_chittor: Sultan Alauddin has taken Chittor. Singers are already making songs about how the women of the fortress chose fire over captivity.
news.n_ind_shah_jalal: They say the Sufi Shah Jalal of Yemen has come to Sylhet in eastern Bengal with three hundred disciples.
news.n_ind_amroha: The sultan's army has utterly defeated the Mongols at Amroha. The prisoners were paraded through Delhi.
news.n_ind_warangal: The general Malik Kafur besieged Warangal, and the Kakatiya king bought him off with treasure – carried, they say, on a thousand camels.
news.n_ind_madurai_raid: Malik Kafur has reached the far south, Madurai, and plundered the temples. No army from Delhi has ever gone so far.
news.n_ind_alauddin_death: Sultan Alauddin has died. They say prices in the bazaars are already creeping up.
news.n_ind_tughluq: After a time of turmoil Ghiyas al-Din Tughluq has taken the throne, and he is building a new fortress near Delhi, Tughlaqabad.
news.n_ind_warangal_fall: Prince Ulugh Khan has taken Warangal. The Kakatiya kingdom has fallen.
news.n_ind_tughluq_death: Sultan Ghiyas al-Din is dead: a wooden pavilion built to welcome him collapsed on him. People whisper it was no accident. The new sultan is his son Muhammad.
news.n_ind_nizamuddin: In Delhi Shaykh Nizamuddin Auliya has died, and soon after his beloved disciple, the poet Amir Khusrau. They were buried side by side.
news.n_ind_daulatabad: They say Sultan Muhammad has ordered all of Delhi to move to Daulatabad, forty days' march to the south.
news.n_ind_ibn_battuta: A scholar from the distant Maghrib named Ibn Battuta has arrived at the sultan's court. The sultan showered him with money and made him qazi of Delhi.
news.n_ind_madurai_sultanate: The governor of Madurai has broken away from Delhi and calls himself sultan. The south is slipping from the Tughluqs' grasp.
news.n_ind_vijaya: Word from the south says the brothers Harihara and Bukka have founded a new capital on the Tungabhadra and do not recognise Delhi's rule.
news.n_ind_sonargaon: In Sonargaon in eastern Bengal Fakhr al-Din Mubarak Shah has declared himself an independent ruler.
news.n_ind_ilyas_rise: They say Ilyas Shah has seized power in Lakhnauti and dreams of bringing all Bengal under his rule.
news.n_ind_battuta_bengal: A traveller from the Maghrib who visited Bengal says nowhere in the world has he seen such cheapness: rice and chickens cost next to nothing there.
news.n_ind_bahmani: In the Deccan rebel amirs have proclaimed Alauddin Bahman Shah sultan. The new sultanate's capital is Gulbarga.
news.n_ind_black_death: Shipmasters from Aden say there is a plague in Egypt and Syria: people die so fast they cannot be buried in time.
news.n_ind_muhammad_death: Sultan Muhammad bin Tughluq has died in Sindh while chasing rebels. A chronicler said: "The sultan was freed of his people, and the people of their sultan." His cousin Firuz has taken the throne.
news.n_ind_ekdala: Sultan Firuz has left Bengal empty-handed: Ilyas Shah held out in the swamp fortress of Ekdala.
news.n_ind_bengal_second: Firuz Shah marched on Bengal again and again came back, settling for peace and gifts.
news.n_ind_jajnagar: Firuz Shah's army crossed Orissa all the way to the sea and ravaged the temple at Puri.
news.n_ind_mudgal: In the south the rayas of Vijayanagara and the Bahmani sultans are fighting over Mudgal. They say firearms were used in battle for the first time.
news.n_ind_ming: Sailors from China say the Mongols have been driven out of China. The new dynasty is called Ming.
news.n_ind_timur_samarkand: Merchants from the north say a lame emir named Timur rules in Samarkand and is gathering a huge army.
news.n_ind_madurai_conquest: Prince Kumara Kampana of Vijayanagara has taken Madurai and restored the temples. His wife, the poet Gangadevi, has described the campaign in verse.
news.n_ind_bukka_death: In Vijayanagara Raya Bukka has died. The throne has passed to his son Harihara II.
news.n_ind_herat: Timur has taken Herat. Persian merchants say no one can stand against him.
news.n_ind_firuz_death: Old Sultan Firuz Shah has died. His grandsons are already squabbling over power, and Delhi is uneasy.
news.n_ind_zafar_khan: Zafar Khan has been appointed governor of Gujarat. They say he hardly listens to Delhi.
news.n_ind_jaunpur: The eunuch Malik Sarwar, governor of the east, has dug in at Jaunpur and rules like a sultan.
news.n_ind_timur_delhi: Terrible news: Timur has taken and sacked Delhi. They say the city burned for many days.
news.n_ind_timur_leaves: Timur has left India, taking captive craftsmen with him. In his wake Delhi suffers famine and plague, and the city is nearly empty.
news.n_ind_timur_death: Merchants from the north say Timur died in winter on his way to China.
news.n_ind_zheng_he: A huge Chinese fleet has arrived at Calicut: dozens of ships bigger than any palace. The admiral has brought gifts from the emperor.
news.n_ind_muzaffar: Zafar Khan has proclaimed himself sultan of Gujarat under the name Muzaffar Shah.
news.n_ind_ahmedabad: They say the new sultan of Gujarat, Ahmad Shah, is building a new capital on the Sabarmati river.
news.n_ind_sayyids: Khizr Khan, Timur's former governor in Multan, now rules in Delhi. The new dynasty is called the Sayyids.
news.n_ind_raja_ganesha: In Bengal a Hindu, Raja Ganesha, has seized power. They say his son has embraced Islam and will be sultan.
news.n_ind_conti: A merchant from Venice has been seen in Vijayanagara. He says the city is sixty miles around and the raya has twelve thousand wives.
news.n_ind_devaraya: Devaraya II has come to the throne in Vijayanagara. They say he is recruiting Muslim archers into his army.
news.n_ind_bidar: The Bahmani sultan has moved his capital from Gulbarga to Bidar.
news.n_ind_kumbha: Rana Kumbha of Mewar has defeated the sultan of Malwa and, they say, kept him prisoner for six months.
news.n_ind_razzaq: The Persian shah's envoy Abd al-Razzaq has visited Vijayanagara and said he had never seen a city like it anywhere on earth.
news.n_ind_victory_tower: In Chittor they have finished the Tower of Victory: nine storeys covered in carved gods.
news.n_ind_lodi: The Afghan Bahlul Lodi has taken the throne of Delhi. His tribesmen are flocking to India for land.
news.n_ind_constantinople: Merchants from Aden say the Turkish sultan Mehmed has taken Constantinople, the capital of the Rumis.
news.n_ind_begada: Young Mahmud has become sultan of Gujarat. They say his moustache is so long he ties it behind his head.
news.n_ind_gawan_regent: The Bahmani sultan has died in Bidar. Affairs are in the hands of the wise vizier Mahmud Gawan, a merchant from Persia.
news.n_ind_nikitin: In Bidar a merchant from the distant northern land of Rus has been seen. He brought a stallion and marvels at everything, especially that everyone here goes barefoot.
news.n_ind_girnar: Sultan Mahmud Begada has taken Girnar and Junagadh, and soon Dwarka as well.
news.n_ind_jaunpur_fall: Bahlul Lodi has subdued Jaunpur. Its last sultan has fled to Bengal.
news.n_ind_gawan_death: In Bidar the old vizier Mahmud Gawan has been executed on the strength of a forged letter. The sultan, they say, realised his mistake too late.
news.n_ind_champaner: After a two-year siege Mahmud Begada has taken the mountain fortress of Champaner.
news.n_ind_habshi: In Bengal the Abyssinian guards, the Habshis, have seized power. Sultans change almost every year.
news.n_ind_bijapur: The Bahmani Sultanate is falling apart: the governors of Bijapur and Ahmadnagar call themselves sultans.
news.n_ind_granada: Pilgrims back from Mecca say that in the far west Granada has fallen, the last Muslim kingdom in the land of the Franks.
news.n_ind_hussain_shah: Alauddin Husain Shah has become sultan of Bengal. They say he has ended the turmoil and welcomes Hindus at his court.
news.n_ind_gama: Three ships of unknown men from the west, the Portuguese, have come to Calicut. They are looking for Christians and spices and say they sailed around Africa.
news.n_ind_nanak_vision: From the Punjab comes word of a young accountant named Nanak who vanished into a river for three days and, on returning, said: "There is no Hindu, there is no Muslim."
news.n_ind_cabral: The Portuguese have returned with cannon and bombarded Calicut. Now their ships sail all along the coast.
news.n_ind_safavid: Merchants from Hormuz say that in Persia the young Shah Ismail has made Shiism the state faith.
news.n_ind_kabul: Prince Babur, a descendant of Timur driven out of Ferghana, has taken Kabul.
news.n_ind_agra: Sultan Sikandar Lodi has moved his court to Agra.
news.n_ind_ceylon: The Portuguese have reached Ceylon and demand cinnamon as the price of peace.
news.n_ind_chaul: The fleets of Egypt and Gujarat have beaten the Portuguese off Chaul. The Portuguese viceroy's son was killed.
news.n_ind_diu: At Diu the Portuguese took their revenge: the Egyptian and Gujarati fleets have been destroyed.
news.n_ind_krishnadevaraya: Krishnadevaraya has ascended the throne of Vijayanagara. They say he is both a warrior and a poet.
news.n_ind_goa: The Portuguese have taken Goa from the sultan of Bijapur and are fortifying it.
news.n_ind_malacca: Gujarati merchants are in turmoil: the Portuguese have taken Malacca, the great spice market of the east.
news.n_ind_chaldiran: They say the Turkish sultan has defeated Shah Ismail at Chaldiran. The Turks' cannon decided the battle.
news.n_ind_ottoman_egypt: Pilgrims say the Turks have conquered Egypt and now guard the road to Mecca.
news.n_ind_ibrahim_lodi: Ibrahim Lodi has taken the throne in Agra. The Afghan nobility is unhappy with him.
news.n_ind_kabir_death: They say the weaver-poet Kabir has died at Maghar. Muslims wanted to bury him and Hindus to cremate him, but under the shroud they found only flowers.
news.n_ind_raichur: Raya Krishnadevaraya has beaten the Bijapuris and taken Raichur.
news.n_ind_gama_death: In Cochin the Portuguese viceroy Vasco da Gama has died – the very man who first sailed into Calicut.
news.n_ind_panipat: Babur of Kabul has defeated Sultan Ibrahim at Panipat. They say he had fire-tubes whose thunder drove the elephants mad.
news.n_ind_khanwa: Padishah Babur has defeated the great Rana Sanga and the Rajput alliance at Khanwa.
news.n_ind_vienna: Merchants from Basra say the Turkish sultan Suleiman besieged distant Vienna but withdrew as winter came.
news.n_ind_kd_death: The great Raya Krishnadevaraya has died. His brother Achyuta has taken the throne.
news.n_ind_babur_death: Padishah Babur has died. They say he offered his life to God in exchange for that of his sick son Humayun.
news.n_ind_chaitanya_death: News from Puri says the saint Chaitanya has left this world. His disciples sing kirtans and weep.
news.n_ind_bassein: The sultan of Gujarat has ceded Bassein and the surrounding villages to the Portuguese.
news.n_ind_bahadur: Sultan Bahadur Shah of Gujarat drowned after talks aboard a Portuguese ship off Diu.
news.n_ind_nanak_death: Guru Nanak has died at Kartarpur. He named as his successor not his son but his disciple Angad.
news.n_ind_kannauj: Sher Shah has defeated Humayun at Kannauj. The padishah has fled west into the deserts of Sindh.
news.n_ind_akbar_born: They say a son has been born to the fugitive padishah Humayun at the fortress of Umarkot. He has been named Akbar.
news.n_ind_xavier: A Portuguese priest, Francis Xavier, has come to Goa. He walks the streets with a little bell, calling children to learn prayers.
news.n_ind_sher_death: Sher Shah has been killed at the siege of Kalinjar when a store of gunpowder exploded.
news.n_ind_mirabai_death: They say the poet Mirabai went into Krishna's temple at Dwarka and was never seen again.
news.n_ind_islam_shah: Islam Shah, Sher Shah's son, has died. The Afghan nobles are dividing the realm.
news.n_ind_humayun_return: Humayun has returned from Persia with an army and taken Delhi again.
news.n_ind_humayun_death: Padishah Humayun fell down the steep stairs of his library and died. His son Akbar is only thirteen.
news.n_ind_panipat2: At Panipat young Akbar and his regent Bairam Khan have defeated Hemu's army.
news.n_ind_bairam: Akbar has dismissed his regent Bairam Khan and sent him off to Mecca. The padishah rules for himself.
news.n_ind_amber: Padishah Akbar has married a princess of Rajput Amber. Her kinsmen now serve at court.
news.n_ind_pilgrim_tax: They say Akbar has abolished the toll on Hindu pilgrims.
news.n_ind_durgavati: Rani Durgavati, ruler of Gondwana, has died fighting the Mughals rather than surrender.
news.n_ind_talikota: Terrible news from the south: the Deccan sultans have crushed Vijayanagara at Talikota, and the City of Victory has been sacked.
news.n_ind_chittor2: After a long siege Akbar has taken Chittor. The Rajput defenders died to the last man.
news.n_ind_salim: An heir has been born to Akbar. He has been named Salim in honour of Shaykh Salim Chishti, who foretold the birth.
news.n_ind_fatehpur: Akbar is building a new capital of red stone near Sikri.
news.n_ind_tulsidas: They say that in Ayodhya the brahmin Tulsidas has begun retelling the Ramayana in the common tongue so that everyone can understand it.
news.n_ind_ibadat: At Fatehpur Sikri the padishah has built a House of Worship and invites scholars of every faith to debate there.
news.n_ind_haldighati: At Haldighati the Mughals have defeated Rana Pratap of Mewar, but the rana himself withdrew into the hills and did not submit.
news.n_ind_amritsar: The Sikh Guru Ram Das is building a new town in the Punjab around a holy pool.
news.n_ind_jesuits: Portuguese Jesuit priests from Goa have arrived at Akbar's court. The padishah enjoys debating with them.
news.n_ind_din_ilahi: They say Akbar has founded his own faith and admits chosen disciples into it.
news.n_ind_ilahi_era: The padishah has introduced a new solar calendar, the "divine era", counted from his accession.
news.n_ind_lahore: Akbar's court has left Fatehpur Sikri for Lahore, closer to the restless northwestern frontier.
news.n_ind_kashmir: Akbar's troops have occupied Kashmir. They say the padishah will spend his summers there.
news.n_ind_fitch: Englishmen have been seen in Bengal, merchants from a land even farther than Portugal. They are asking about the price of cloth.
news.n_ind_armada: The Portuguese in Goa are gloomy: they say their king's great fleet has been lost off the coast of England.
news.n_ind_hyderabad: The sultan of Golconda has founded a new city, Hyderabad, with a four-minaret tower at its heart.
news.n_ind_chand_bibi: Chand Bibi, regent of Ahmadnagar, has repulsed a Mughal assault herself. They sing of her courage in the bazaars.
news.n_ind_ain: The learned vizier Abu'l-Fazl, they say, has finished a vast description of Akbar's empire: every province, tax and custom, and even the court's recipes.
news.n_ind_ahmadnagar: The Mughals have taken Ahmadnagar. Chand Bibi died before the final assault.
news.n_ind_voc: Dutch ships have appeared in the harbours, yet another kind of firangi, at war with the Portuguese.
news.n_ind_adi_granth: Guru Arjan has gathered the hymns of the Gurus and of saints such as Kabir and Farid into one book and installed it in the temple at Amritsar.
news.n_ind_akbar_death: The great Padishah Akbar has died. His son Salim has taken the throne under the name Jahangir.
news.n_ind_guru_arjan: In Lahore the Sikh Guru Arjan has been put to death on the padishah's orders. His followers are in mourning.
news.n_ind_hawkins: An English captain has arrived at Jahangir's court in Agra. He is asking for leave to trade at Surat.
news.n_ind_mysore: The ruler of Mysore has taken Srirangapatna from the raya's viceroy and made it his capital.
news.n_ind_nur_jahan: Padishah Jahangir has married a Persian widow, Nur Jahan. They say she now holds the seal.
news.n_ind_swally: Off Surat English ships have beaten the Portuguese. The English are opening a trading house in Surat.
news.n_ind_roe: An ambassador of the English king has arrived at the padishah's court. The courtiers laugh at his gifts.
news.n_ind_plague_1616: There is pestilence in the Punjab and around Agra: people break out in swellings and die within days.
news.n_ind_kangra: After a long siege the Mughals have taken the mountain fortress of Kangra.
news.n_ind_hormuz: The Persian shah, with English help, has taken Hormuz from the Portuguese. The merchants of Gujarat are rubbing their hands.
news.n_ind_khurram: Prince Khurram has rebelled against his father the padishah. Armies are marching through the Deccan and Bengal.
news.n_ind_jahangir_death: Padishah Jahangir has died. Prince Khurram has become padishah under the name Shah Jahan.
news.n_ind_famine_1630: Terrible news of famine comes from Gujarat and the Deccan: whole villages are dying out.
news.n_ind_mumtaz: In Burhanpur the padishah's beloved wife Mumtaz Mahal has died. They say Shah Jahan turned grey overnight.
news.n_ind_hooghly: The Mughals have taken Portuguese Hooghly in Bengal. The Portuguese captives have been led away to Agra.
news.n_ind_peacock: A throne in the shape of a peacock, of gold and precious stones, has been made for the padishah. They say it took seven years.
news.n_ind_madras: The English have obtained a strip of shore in the south from a nayaka and are building a fort there: Madras.
news.n_ind_malacca_dutch: The Dutch have taken Malacca from the Portuguese.
news.n_ind_shahjahanabad: The padishah has ceremonially entered his new capital Shahjahanabad and the Red Fort.
news.n_ind_kandahar: The Persian shah has taken Kandahar. Mughal campaigns to win it back came to nothing.
news.n_ind_taj: They say the white marble tomb of Mumtaz Mahal in Agra is finished, and there is nothing more beautiful on earth.
news.n_ind_samugarh: The sick Shah Jahan's sons are fighting for the throne. Aurangzeb has defeated Dara at Samugarh and locked their father up in Agra.
news.n_ind_dara: Prince Dara Shukoh, who translated the Upanishads into Persian, has been executed on his brother's orders.
news.n_ind_surat: The Maratha chief Shivaji has plundered Surat. The merchants hid for three days in the English trading house.
news.n_ind_chittagong: The governor Shaista Khan has taken Chittagong. The raids of the Arakanese pirates, they say, are over.
news.n_ind_shahjahan_death: In Agra old Shah Jahan has died, after eight years of gazing from his prison window at his wife's tomb.
news.n_ind_vishwanath: In Benares the Vishvanath temple has been demolished on the padishah's orders. Pilgrims pray by the ruins.
news.n_ind_shivaji_crowned: Shivaji has been crowned at Raigad as an independent king of the Marathas.
news.n_ind_tegh_bahadur: In Delhi the Sikh Guru Tegh Bahadur has been executed. They say he had spoken up for the brahmins of Kashmir.
news.n_ind_jizya_1679: Padishah Aurangzeb has reimposed the jizya on non-Muslims, which Akbar had abolished long ago.
news.n_ind_shivaji_death: Shivaji has died. The Marathas swear to carry on his cause.
